claimBoundary: The matrix uses only one-component 8x8 8-bit JPEGs, so the decoded 64-byte PGM raster is exactly one component block and cannot be affected by chroma upsampling or color conversion.

For every generated JPEG, a pinned libjpeg-turbo coefficient API probe extracts the actual quantized 8x8 coefficient block and the actual quantization table in natural order. ImageCraft receives only those 128 UInt16 words and a caller-owned 256-byte Int32 workspace plus 64-byte destination.

The reference raster is decoded with the same pinned libjpeg-turbo installation using the accurate integer DCT path. ImageCraft's dequantization + ISLOW IDCT output must equal all 64 reference samples byte-for-byte; no tolerance or cross-backend RGB conversion is involved.

The package primitive fails closed if a quantizer is outside 1...255 or any dequantized coefficient does not fit Int16. Passing the matrix qualifies only the generated legal-block domain that satisfies this precondition; it does not qualify entropy parsing, multi-block traversal, scaled IDCT, 12/16-bit sample paths or a production JPEG backend.
